writ of execution: a routine court order that attempts to enforce the judgment that has been granted to a plaintiff by authorizing a sheriff to carry it out
wrong 'un: a cricket ball bowled as if to break one way that actually breaks in the opposite way
xerox copy: a copy made by a xerographic copier
yellow water flag: common yellow-flowered iris of Europe and North Africa, naturalized in United States and often cultivated
